title: Week 04 — vending is four operations across three APIs, not one
alt: Architecture diagram. A request carrying a landing zone name, owner and budget goes to the Subscription Alias API, which creates a subscription at tenant level and is irreversible. The alias API leaves every subscription under the Tenant Root Group, so a separate call to the Management Groups API places it at mg-lz-dev. Only then are a consumption budget and a role assignment applied. Create without place and the result is a subscription that is billed, healthy, and inherits nothing.

groups.label: four operations, three APIs — and the order is the whole lesson
